content:
ben_sales: Quick sync: Orion Biotech asking for non-standard billing on their POC/rollout. Request: Net120 on final invoice, split across 4 invoices (20% kick, 30% pilot acceptance, 30% production go-live, 20% 12mo). Also want a 'data residency & audit' escrow line item. Can deal desk + finance take this?
nina_dealdesk: That Net120 is long. We can consider up to Net90 with extra safeguards. Asking for 15% off list if they sign 2yr commit. @carlos_finance what are our limits?
carlos_finance: Long receivables ok if secured. Options: (a) 20% refundable deposit up-front, (b) bank guarantee, or (c) credit insurance. For mixed-term invoices we need clear revenue recognition mapping in SOW. Any single ARR > $200k triggers CFO review.
jen_se: Technical note: POC will use Private deployment in EU region for first 6 months. We'll need pinned model SHA and audit logs for compliance. That affects the pricing tiers and SLOs in SOW.
ben_sales: Customer says procurement only approves Net120 for third/fourth invoices, but can prepay first 50% within 30 days. They prefer the escrow to cover configuration and runbooks, not raw data.
nina_dealdesk: Draft conditional combo we can try:
```
- 20% refundable deposit due on signature (prepay)
- 30% on pilot acceptance (invoice Net30) w/ acceptance criteria in SOW
- 30% on production go-live (invoice Net60)
- 20% final at 12mo (invoice Net120) with 6mo true-up window
- Escrow limited to operational runbooks, code hashes, and recovery scripts only; customer data excluded
- 12% volume discount for 2yr committed ARR >= $150k
```
jen_se: Acceptance criteria we recommend: latency p95 <= 250ms on customer's test harness and successful security smoke tests (SCA + OWASP scan pass). Use that to gate the pilot invoice.
carlos_finance: Finance can accept mixed invoice terms if deposit >=20% and we have an approved credit limit or bank guarantee. We'll require AR hold and monthly aging reporting. CFO sign-off if total contract value > $300k.
legal-bot: :warning: Escrow clause flagged for legal review. Please attach proposed escrow language.
ben_sales: I'll loop legal and procurement. @nina_dealdesk can you prepare a term sheet variant with the conditional language? We'll push the 12% discount in exchange for 2yr commit.
nina_dealdesk: On it. ETA tomorrow morning.
carlos_finance: I'll run a soft credit check today and confirm deposit mechanism (card/ACH/bank transfer).
jen_se: Filing note: add model pin/version and audit logging requirement to SOW before pilot acceptance.
ben_sales: Thanks everyone — keeping Orion warm. Will post updates once legal weighs in. :thumbsup:
